B1 · HARBOR LIGHTS  — Sean's pick

Sean's header is REPLICATED at the top, unchanged: 64px fixed glass, blur(20px) saturate(1.8), real nav (Home / Store / Video Library / Waiver / Contact / Photography / About) + Login / Sign Up. The design adapts BELOW it. Its own left rail is a SECTION rail, not a second nav.

HERO = the Swans.mp4 video slot (real frame shown). Swappable for an H3 film later.

2 MOVIE AREAS: "The Harbor at Night" and "One Session, End to End".

5 parallax stages: hero · window-wall band · movie 1 · golf band · movie 2.

D2 · VEGAS MILE  — Sean's pick

Sean's header is REPLICATED at the top, unchanged. The marquee bulb strip moved BELOW his header so it never competes with it.

HERO = the Swans.mp4 video slot (real frame shown), with neon type over it. Swappable for an H3 film later.

2 MOVIE AREAS: "Neon Mile, Opening Night" and "The Record, In Motion".

5 parallax stages: hero · movie 1 · skyline band · movie 2 · (block tints).

TRADEOFF: loudest of the eight and the furthest from "homey"; highest perf cost.

KILL PASS — 2026-08-19

Sean: "I like d two and b one."
Six directions killed. These two survive.

HIS FOUR INSTRUCTIONS, ALL APPLIED:
1. KEEP THE HEADER. "not gonna get rid of my header or change that style in any way. They need to adapt to what I already have." Both boards replicate components/Header/header.tsx and lay out below it.
2. MORE PARALLAX — 5 depth stages per board, not just the hero.
3. AT LEAST 2 MOVIE AREAS between sections for MiniMax H3 films — both boards have two, each with a brief and a duration.
4. THE HERO IS THE SWANS VIDEO — real frame from the real Swans.mp4. Kept, and marked as a swappable slot in case an H3 film beats it.

Gold tags = new copy needing approval.
